correctness.rationale: PASS: On the unit sphere of N_ω, solve max²+ω min²=1 to obtain ||x||₂²=2/(1+ω)−[(1−ω)/(1+ω)]D(x). For arbitrary chord z the exact identity N_ω(z)²=||z||₂²−(1−ω)m(z)² holds. Choosing σ with σ<x,y>=|<x,y>| makes ||x−σy||₂²=||x||₂²+||y||₂²−2|<x,y>|; since F²<=N(x−σy)², substitution proves precisely the three-term lower bound. Sign-reflected x=(a,b),y=(a,-b), a>=b>=0, a²+ωb²=1, yields F=2b and both sides=4(a²−b²)/(1+ω), verifying full continuous equality. Zero deficit forces diagonal, Euclidean-orthogonal extremal orbit; using J²−F²≤2J epsilon gives the three stated near-extremizer estimates. Every step algebraic, not inferred from numerical stress tests.
